messages:
Alicia M: Pushed a new prototype for Embeddings > Batch import flow with a separate "Vectors preview" modal + Rerank results table. Would love quick UX + a11y checks before I send to eng.
Sam K: looked it over. Nice direction. Two quick asks: 1) how are we handling huge vector cells in the table? 2) CSV/JSONL naming conventions for fields.
Priya R: For vector cells I suggest a tiny sparkline + a collapsed row showing first 5 dims then “…”. Add a "View full vector" keyboard-focusable button that opens a modal with copy and download.
Marco L: sounds good. Also please round display values to 3 decimals. Include a way to copy the full precision vector. For downloads we should include full precision in JSONL/CSV.
Jordan (UX): Accessibility notes: the "View full vector" must be reachable by keyboard and use aria-modal. Use aria-live for upload/job status updates. For the table, aria-sort and aria-rowindex need to be present for screen readers.
Alicia M: Copy question: CSV header naming. Current mock uses `id, text, vector_0..vector_n, relevance`. Is `vector_` prefix OK or should we use `embedding_`?
Sam K: prefer `vector_` to avoid confusion with downstream systems that expect "vector". Also add a `metadata` column for JSON blobs if present.
Priya R: include a small preview mapping step on import: show first 4 rows and let users map columns to {id, text, metadata}. Defaults via heuristics but allow edit. UX: show sample row bytes and estimated file size after upload.
Marco L: backend note: enforce a soft warning when file > 200MB or rows >50k. Provide an option to chunk the job into N pieces automatically. Also include a progress bar with percentage and ETA.
Jordan (UX): visual/accessibility: contrast of the relevance heatmap needs to meet AA in both light/dark. Provide a patterned fallback or text label for colorblind users. Also, ensure focus ring visible in high-contrast modes.
Alicia M: Rerank table: thoughts on showing both original and candidate side-by-side vs stacked? The mock uses side-by-side which gets wide.
Sam K: stacked (original above candidate) keeps width reasonable on mobile. For desktop allow a split-view toggle. Keep the primary column as searchable text.
Priya R: add inline "diff" toggle per row to highlight changed tokens between original and candidate (collapsed by default). Might help reviewers.
Marco L: extra data point: scores can be negative for some models. The chart/histogram scale should auto-center at 0 when negatives present and show min/max labels.
Jordan (UX): keyboard selection: support Shift+Arrow and Shift+Click for range selection and Ctrl/Cmd+Click for multi-select. Selected rows expose actions: Export selection, Recompute score, Add to dataset. Make sure buttons have aria-labels like "Export selected rows as CSV".
Alicia M: Export modal copy: title "Export results". Options: format (CSV, JSONL), include vectors (full precision), include metadata. Warn: exports may be large and will be prepared in background; link expires in 48 hours. Primary CTA: "Start export". Thoughts?
Sam K: add checkbox option "Chunk export into files of max N rows" to avoid timeouts. For CSV example header include column names: `id,text,vector_0,...,vector_n,relevance,metadata`.
Priya R: wording tweak: change "include vectors (full precision)" -> "Include full-precision vectors (larger file sizes)". Also add an "Export in background" note with email/notification option.
Marco L: engineering: we'll implement background job with pre-signed URL. Add retention policy note: "Download link expires after 48 hours". Will add server-side chunking.
design-bot: snapshot saved: /design/snapshots/embeddings-batch-preview-v4.png (v4) :white_check_mark:
Jordan (UX): small copy nits: change table action "Copy" to "Copy vector to clipboard" and provide ARIA live confirmation "Vector copied". Also ensure live region for job completion says "Export ready: 1 file available".
Sam K: front-end implementation detail: for the preview modal keyboard shortcut propose `v` when focus in table opens vector modal. Needs to be documented in keyboard help.
Priya R: add a compact mode toggle (no sparklines, minimal spacing) to reduce vertical density for power users. Also a "Show vector fingerprint" option (short hash) to help dedupe.
Marco L: include server-side validation errors in import UI, show sample row number and error message inline.
Alicia M: action items: Priya update import mapping mock + compact mode; Jordan add aria-live/spec for job + keyboard shortcuts; Marco write export chunking & size limits for eng; Sam produce CSV/JSONL header spec and keyboard shortcut doc. I'll consolidate and send to eng after updates.
Priya R: will update mock this afternoon.
Jordan (UX): drafting a11y checklist now.
Marco L: I'll post the chunking limits and ETA algorithm details tomorrow.
Sam K: working on header spec, will share soon.
Alicia M: thanks all, this was super helpful :thumbsup:
